title: Model-Fit Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Calculate the memory a model needs from its parameter count, precision, and context length, state whether it fits, then explore seven inputs.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the memory a model needs from its parameter count, precision, and context length, to within 1 GB, and state the fit verdict, for 3 challenges.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Committed calculation with two attempts, followed by free exploration
keyQuestions: In challenge 3 the model loads and the verdict is still not "Fits". Explain what the headroom is for on a unified-memory machine.
commonMisconceptions: A 4-bit file uses exactly 4 bits per parameter.
The context length does not change memory until the conversation is long.
A model that loads has therefore fit.
A larger memory always means a bigger model can be run.
